subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**numeral**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage talks about the development of the numerical system, where zero played a crucial role.
 
• The word "**numeral**" refers to a symbol or group of symbols representing a number, which fits well in the context.
 
• "**Numerological**" and "**numerology**" relate to the mystical study of numbers, which is unrelated to the mathematical system discussed here.
 
• "**Numerically**" is an adverb and does not fit grammatically in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
